source.boundary: User highlighted extent approximated in WGS84
source.navigation: Mapped pedestrian paths plus reconstructed roadside sidewalks along OSM public streets. Unmapped sidewalk widths and junction crossing layouts are approximate. Expressways/private/foot-prohibited/tunnel streets excluded.
source.elevation: Mapzen / Tilezen Skadi 1 arc second elevation, N37E127
source.contours: 10 m contours derived from the same elevation grid as the 3D scene
source.crossings: OpenStreetMap API /api/0.6/map bbox 127.0765,37.308,127.104,37.331; acquired 2026-11-05; 227 mapped crossing nodes, not a survey
source.streetFurniture: OSM bus_stop/subway_entrance/shelter nodes, queried 2026-11-06; bus poles offset onto nearest street verge when needed.

walkingDedupe.method: Reuse mapped pedestrian corridors instead of overlapping reconstructed sidewalks; parallel tolerance 2.25 m, ground junction tolerance 1.25 m; mapped source geometry retained

walkingUnion.method: Split intersecting mapped/inferred pedestrian segments at one shared node only when modelled heights agree; retain grade-separated routes

roadUnion.method: Integer polygon union of ground carriageways clipped to shared 16 m cells for elevation sampling; bridges stay separate

walkwayNetwork.method: Shared ground walking corridors; intersecting ground grades reconciled within 1.1m. Bridge/tunnel levels remain separate, and stacked road profiles receive separate nodes.

walkwayUnion.method: Integer polygon union per local vertical corridor; one non-overlapping ground walking surface, independent of navigation graph

stackedWalkNodeRepair.method: Keep crossings with road-profile clearance on separate walking levels; never average their sidewalk endpoints into a steep invented ramp.
